_comment: Wallapop category 14000 = whole motorbikes; 12800 is where the parts and the despieces live (measured 2026-10-16 against the live search). THRESHOLDS IN THIS FILE ARE PLACEHOLDERS, not measurements: the bicycle pack's numbers were tuned against seven probes over six weeks and none of that transfers. Run ./calibrate.py arms before you trust a digest from this pack.

scooter._comment: Body type is the motorbike equivalent of drop bars: it is the one thing CLIP answers well. Flip the positives if you are looking for a scooter rather than a motorcycle.
positives: a photo of a motorcycle with a fuel tank between the rider's knees, a naked or sport motorcycle
negatives: a photo of a step-through scooter with a flat footboard
a photo of a moped or 50cc scooter
a photo of a quad or ATV
a photo of a motorcycle part or fairing, not a whole motorcycle
a photo of an electric scooter with a standing deck

luggage._comment: The distinctive-accessory arm -- the equivalent of the child seat on the bicycle pack, and the arm that survives a repaint. Change it to whatever is bolted to YOURS: top box, crash bars, panniers, a windscreen.
positives: a photo of a motorcycle with a top box or hard luggage cases fitted
negatives: a photo of a motorcycle with no luggage or accessories

colour._comment: PLACEHOLDER BAND -- red. `./calibrate.py colour` reads the real band off your own reference photos; do that before you rely on this arm. Hue in degrees, 0-360, red at 0 and wrapping.

prompt.intro:
You are helping find ONE specific stolen motorbike in marketplace photos.
Reference photos of it are attached first — study them before judging.
prompt.scoring: Score how plausibly the photo could be THIS motorbike, 0-10:
prompt.bands:
0-1  wrong genre entirely — a scooter when you want a motorcycle
      (or the reverse), a quad, a bicycle, a spare part, a fairing, or not
      a motorbike at all
 2-3  the right genre but clearly a different machine — wrong body shape,
      wrong engine size class, or plainly the wrong colour
 4-5  right genre and plausible size, but nothing specific lines up
 6-7  several specific features line up: e.g. the colour AND the body shape,
      or the frame/tank silhouette, or the luggage and crash protection
 8-10 could really be it: tank and fairing shape, colour and the fitted kit
      all agree, or a visible distinguishing mark matches
prompt.closing:
Use the whole range. Judge what you can actually see; if the photo is too
small, dark or cropped to tell, say so in the reason and score the middle.

Number plates and VINs are usually blurred or removed in listings — do not
rely on them, and do not refuse to score because they are missing.

_comment_gate_arms: The arms the pre-gate is allowed to use. Arms outside this list still score and still rank the digest, but never decide whether a photo is paid for -- 'steel' on the bicycle pack is a tie-breaker and far too noisy to gate on (it reads 0.81 on a dim photo of the bike's own drive side).
